evals.expected_output: Explains that the remaining PATHOUT lines are per-batch ('PATHOUT=4 nr=20 n: batch 645') and do not name functions; re-runs cov-analyze on a copy with the original options plus --print-paths (reading the original command line from the log's first line) and collects 'Pathed out: N paths traversed by <checker> in "<signature>"' lines; notes that the count depends on the checker set (16 at defaults vs 189 with --all --aggressiveness-level high); offers tools/pathout_report.py.
assertions: Identifies batch work-unit lines as the reason only three functions are named
Re-runs with --print-paths using the same options as the original run, on a copy
Produces the per-function, per-checker list from the Pathed out lines

evals.prompt: setup_env in modules/mod_auth.c (TU 77 of the proftpd idir at C:\Data\CoveritySkills\coverity-demo-data-workspace\idirs\v1.3.9, Coverity 2025.9.0) hits the path limit.
